description: This file is a bootstrap file for the Symfony Polyfill library for PHP 8.1. It conditionally defines functions and constants to provide compatibility for PHP versions earlier than 8.1.

methods.name: array_is_list
methods.description: A polyfill method for PHP 8.1's array_is_list function, delegating to Symfony Polyfill implementation.

methods.name: enum_exists
methods.description: A custom function to check if an enum exists, with a false return if autoloading does not confirm class existence.
